rules: R1 trait: the score is mapped to the requested ontology trait (PGS Catalog trait_efo).
R2 overall disease: trait_reported is the overall disease label (subtype- or sex-restricted labels such as 'Breast cancer (ER-positive)' or 'Breast cancer (female)' are excluded).
R3 array-scoreable: at most 1000 variants (ClawBio scores array/DTC genotypes without imputation; genome-wide scores need imputed or sequenced data).
R4 evaluated: at least one evaluation unit (publication, sample set) in the Catalog.
R5 order: more evaluation units first; then more distinct single-ancestry evaluation groups; then earlier release date (longer track record); then PGS id.
R6 take the top 3. Ranking uses Catalog metadata only and is fixed before any personal scoring.

comparison.status_rule: NOT_COMPARABLE unless >= 2 supported scores share a reference population and method; then STABLE if their percentiles span <= 20 points, else UNSTABLE (display heuristic, never a gate threshold)
comparison.note: Only PERCENTILE_SUPPORTED scores are compared, side by side. Different scores are different measurements: their percentiles are not averaged, and the comparison never selects the primary score.

may: recover (re-run after an input or network error with the same rules)
may_not: choose a score by its resulting PRS or percentile
re-run until an outcome is favourable
invent or fill in missing evidence

min_variant_coverage.source: Engineering default borrowed from the PGS Catalog Calculator (pgsc_calc) --min_overlap default of 0.75 (nextflow_schema.json), counting called, allele-verified, non-ambiguous variants as pgsc_calc does by default (keep_ambiguous=false). It is an overlap floor for computing a score at all; it is not a clinical cutoff.

min_percentile_basis_coverage.source: Same pgsc_calc-derived engineering floor, applied to the variants the percentile reference was computed on; not a clinical cutoff.

min_ancestry_probability.source: PRSGuard project policy for the top ancestry probability (must be a probability in [0, 1]). Ancestry posteriors in ClawBio are not calibrated; this is not a validated statistical threshold.

required_arp_confidence.source: PRSGuard project policy over ancestry-risk-profiler's own categories (high = log-likelihood gap > 50 between the top two populations).

policy.declared_evidence: Identity, coverage and percentile basis in an evidence file are declared, not computed by PRSGuard, and cannot be verified: declared PRS evidence can at most yield RAW_SCORE_ONLY.
policy.supported_score_models: Additive scores with log-scale weights (beta, log(OR), log(HR), or not reported). Ratio-scale weight types (OR, HR, RR, 'Odds Ratio over expected risk'), interaction terms and dosage-specific or haplotype/diplotype/dominant/recessive encodings are not what gwas-prs computes (sum of weight x dosage), so the raw score would not be the published score.
policy.non_matching_rationale: Not reported (NR), multi-ancestry (MAE/MAO, including pooled sample sets), additional Asian (ASN), Greater Middle Eastern (GME) and other (OTH) evaluation units do not establish performance in any single 1000 Genomes super-population.
